answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The forge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zenith is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
